amendments.description: Added the already executed CPU device and batch size so the runner can reject protocol/runtime mismatches. No model, data, split, density, metric, or result choice changed.

comparators.Laplace-fixed-context: Fresh Laplace state per origin, updated with exactly the same preceding 128 changes.
comparators.TiRex-2: Native q10..q90 from exactly the preceding 128 changes.
comparators.laplace: Causal online Laplace using up to the retained 1000-change history; reported separately because information differs.

density_reconstruction.kind: fixed-bandwidth Gaussian-mixture reconstruction from ordered q10..q90
density_reconstruction.selection: One global multiplier maximizing equal-series validation mean logpdf with a -20 floor; freeze it before test scoring.
density_reconstruction.tail_semantics: No explicit tail law is supplied by TiRex-2. The reconstructed density is an evaluation convention, not a native TiRex-2 likelihood.

identifiers.Table-R1: unresolved from Issue 138 and public source searches as of 2026-07-28
identifiers.TwbFB: unresolved from Issue 138 and public source searches as of 2026-07-28

limitations: This is a 24-series, 64-origin-per-series M4-hourly panel, not a population-wide benchmark.
Pretraining overlap is unresolved; the TiRex-2 model card lists broad public time-series corpora, so this is not evidence of contamination-free generalization.
Only one-step univariate forecasts without covariates are evaluated.
TiRex-2 provides nine central quantiles rather than a native likelihood or explicit tails; density metrics depend on the validation-frozen reconstruction.
The full-history Laplace comparator receives more history than TiRex-2 and is not an equal-information comparison.
Table-R1 and TwbFB remain unidentified; this benchmark does not claim to reproduce either one.
The protocol is registered in-repository rather than in an independent timestamped registry, and two H1 execution smokes preceded it.

metrics.aggregation: Equal-series means for overall logpdf, CRPS, and coverage; paired per-series medians and means for effect summaries.

question: How does the public TiRex-2 checkpoint perform against causal Laplace forecasts on a small frozen M4-hourly panel under a matched one-step protocol?

source.name: M4 hourly training source
source.preprocessing: Use at most the final 1000 changes per series. Strictly positive levels become log differences; otherwise first differences, matching benchmarks/corpus.py.
source.selection: First 24 qualifying rows in source order after the repository's causal level-to-change transform.

splits.target_exclusion: Each model input ends immediately before the realized target.
splits.test: final 64 origins, not used for density selection
splits.validation: 64 origins immediately before the test window

status: Protocol fixed before the full 24-series benchmark. Two adapter smokes on H1 (2 and 128 final origins) preceded this file and were used only to verify execution and throughput; their scores were not used to choose protocol settings.
